description: This file defines a class ADODB_pdo_mssql which extends the ADODB_pdo class to provide database driver functionality specific to Microsoft SQL Server using PDO in PHP. It includes methods for initializing the driver, retrieving server info, setting transaction modes, and metadata retrieval functions.

classes.name: ADODB_pdo_mssql
classes.description: Provides PDO-based MSSQL database driver functionalities, including transaction management and server info retrieval.

methods.name: _init
methods.description: Initializes the driver, setting transaction support and input binding configurations.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Returns server information by invoking ADOConnection::ServerInfo.

methods.name: SelectLimit
methods.description: Executes a SQL query with limit and offset options, utilizing ADOConnection::SelectLimit.

methods.name: SetTransactionMode
methods.description: Sets the transaction isolation level for the current connection.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Placeholder method for retrieving metadata about tables; returns false.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Placeholder method for retrieving metadata about columns; returns false.
